purpose: Core AI agent framework with ORM, code generation, AI-powered operations, and automatic API/CLI/MCP server generation.

patterns.name: @smrt() decorator
patterns.description: Registers class for automatic API/CLI/MCP generation. Configure which endpoints, tools, and commands to generate.

patterns.name: TypeScript types for schema
patterns.description: Use TypeScript types for automatic database schema generation. The AST scanner infers column types from default values.
patterns.example:
class Product extends SmrtObject {
  name: string = '';        // TEXT
  quantity: number = 0;     // INTEGER (no decimal)
  price: number = 0.0;      // DECIMAL (has decimal)
  active: boolean = true;   // BOOLEAN
  tags: string[] = [];      // JSON
}

patterns.name: Static factory for collections
patterns.description: Collections use static create() method for guaranteed initialization. Never use 'new' directly.

patterns.name: AI-powered operations
patterns.description: Built-in is() and do() methods for AI-powered validation and transformation on every object.

patterns.name: Custom action methods
patterns.description: Define custom methods on SMRT objects and expose them via API, MCP, or CLI by including them in the decorator config.

pitfalls: Always use `smrt test` instead of `npx vitest` directly - tests require manifest generation first
Never override toJSON() without calling super.toJSON() - breaks STI and meta fields
Collections require static _itemClass property: `static readonly _itemClass = Product;`
Always call initialize() after creating objects with 'new', or use collection.create() which calls it automatically
UNIQUE constraint is on (slug, context) pair - same slug allowed in different contexts
Query operators go in field name: `{ 'price >': 100 }` not `{ price: '> 100' }`
Use 0 for integers (INTEGER) and 0.0 for decimals (DECIMAL) in default values
